name: Documents
description: Read, make and edit Word, PDF, Markdown and text files.
abilities: Reads Word documents, PDFs, Markdown and text files, and cites PDF pages
Writes reports, letters and notes as Word documents or PDFs, with headings, lists, tables and pictures
Adds to a document, or changes words in it and keeps its formatting
Saves every file in your Workspace files, ready to download
permissions: Reads files in your workspace and files you attach
Makes and changes files in your offline sandbox, with no network
Asks before changing files once it has read outside content
